items.title: Hundreds missing in Nepal catastrophic flash floods
items.standfirst: Massive flash floods in Nepal on Wednesday killed at least 22 people and left hundreds of tourists, workers and others missing after sweeping through communities and bringing travel in parts of the Himalayan country to a halt. China's government across the northern border also launched search and rescue efforts, with major casualties in the border area of Gyirong, state broadcaster CCTV reported. No toll was immediately reported.

items.title: Meta Settlement Sets Blueprint for TikTok, YouTube

items.title: Meta reaches $17 billion settlement with US states over social media harm to teens

The company agreed to add child-safety measures as part of the settlement.

items.title: Gang attack in Haiti: Anger mounts over police failures
items.standfirst: At least 47 people were killed and more than 50 others kidnapped after armed men attacked a once-peaceful community near Haiti’s capital earlier this week, the United Nations said Tuesday. It is believed to be one of the largest mass kidnappings in Haiti in recent years, and one gang leader is threatening to kill the hostages if authorities kill any gang members as they try to secure the community nestled in the hills above Port-au-Prince. Sunday’s attack on Kenscoff pierced the belief that security in the troubled Caribbean country was improving. Journalist Harold Isaac reports from Port-au-Prince, Haiti.
